title: What matters when building vision-language models?
grouping: A single left-to-right chain on the upper half: image icon (with an 'Up to 980x980' size label above it), vision encoder box, 'Hidden states' drawn as two small stacks of green squares, a modality projection + pooling box, and two more stacks marked '64'. The language model is turned into a tall vertical peach bar at the right edge; its input sequence is a single column of squares down its left side, green runs for image tokens (with ':64' ellipses) interleaved with dark orange text tokens, and the outputs are orange squares on its right. Text enters as a large serif 'T' glyph at the lower left whose long line runs along the bottom and branches up into the column.
shapes_depth: Flat, square-cornered boxes with thin dark outlines and pale fills (teal encoder, pale blue projection, peach LLM), no shadows. Feature maps and tokens are small squares with outlines; the hidden states are drawn as offset stacks of three squares with a dotted ellipsis, a flat stand-in for a 3-D tensor. Heavy black arrows with filled heads link the chain; the text branches end in hollow triangular arrowheads. Labels are serif.
proposed_highlight: No module is singled out; the eye goes to the two-colour token column beside the LLM, where green visual-token runs interleave with the orange text tokens and a '64' count marks how many tokens one image becomes.
lesson: Turn the LLM into a tall vertical bar at the right edge and stack its input sequence as one column of squares down its left side, so interleaved image-token runs (green, counted '64') and text tokens (orange) read as one ordered sequence.
notes: Title on arXiv is the study's; the caption and figure name the model Idefics2. No venue on the PDF or arXiv page; year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: green visual-token stacks and orange text-token squares interleave in one input column along the left edge of a tall peach LLM bar, with an image path along the top and a text line along the bottom curving into it

relations.form: top row left to right: image icon 'Up to 980x980' -> Vision encoder -> stacked green 'Hidden states' -> Modality projection + Pooling -> green stacks marked '64'

curved black arrows carry each pooled 64-token group into its slot of the LLM's input column, while hollow-headed arrows from the bottom text line enter at the orange slots, so green and orange cells alternate
image path along the top, text path as one long horizontal line along the bottom from a large serif 'TT' glyph, both ending at the LLM column

channels.colour: green = visual tokens/hidden states, dark orange = text tokens (input and output); module fills (teal encoder, pale blue projection, peach LLM) only separate modules
channels.shape: stacked squares = token groups, single squares = tokens, rounded rectangles = modules, a tall bar = LLM
channels.line: solid black arrowheads = visual-token routing, hollow arrowheads = text-token routing; all solid lines

quality.strengths: Interleaving is drawn as data: the LLM's input column literally alternates green image-token cells and orange text-token cells, and the same orange reappears on the outputs, so 'images inserted into the text sequence' reads without text.
quality.weaknesses: The text input is a large serif 'TT' glyph with no example text; curved routing arrows cross each other just before the LLM; the image is an icon, not a sample; the 64-token pooling, the paper's efficiency point, is only a small ':64' label.

insights.structure: A single top row Vision encoder -> hidden states -> 'Modality projection + Pooling' feeds a tall peach LLM column at the right, while a text line runs along the bottom into the same column.
insights.data: The image is an icon with 'Up to 980x980'; hidden states are stacked green squares, pooled visual tokens are labelled '64', and text tokens are dark orange squares, so the LLM's input column interleaves green and orange cells.
insights.emphasis: Colour carries the message: green visual tokens and orange text tokens alternate in the LLM's input column, showing images inserted into the text sequence.
insights.flow: Left to right, image path on top and text path along the bottom, both curving into the LLM's input column; outputs exit right as orange squares.
insights.avoid: The big serif 'TT' glyph for text and the curved arrows that cross each other just before the LLM are clumsy; no loss is shown.

arrangement.units: one pipeline with module boxes (teal encoder, blue projection, tall peach LLM) and no enclosing frames
arrangement.inputs_as: an image icon with resolution text and a text glyph
